mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (over the prior 3 months) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% within the last month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and industrial production indicate a broad-based economic slowdown, reducing corporate revenue expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in < 40% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL year-over-year change exceeding 3.5%), the Federal Reserve's expected tightening policy increases real interest rates, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1150 thousand units in the prior month signals weak consumer demand for housing, reducing construction sector activity and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (over the prior 3 months) indicates strong manufacturing activity, boosting corporate profits and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in rising INDPRO periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and increases in non-farm payrolls indicate a strong labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in < 40% of instances where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 440,000 million dollars in the prior month signals reduced consumer spending, lowering corporate revenue expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
